sloka: कथं दशरथाज्जात: शुद्धाभिजनकर्मण: ।जानन् धर्ममधर्मिष्ठं कुर्य्यां कर्म जुगुप्सितम् ॥ २.१०६.१०॥
transliteration: kathaṁ daśarathājjāta: śuddhābhijanakarmaṇa: ।jānan dharmamadharmiṣṭhaṁ kuryyāṁ karma jugupsitam ॥ 2.106.10॥

translations.english: How shall I, born to Dasaratha of noble race and righteous deeds, with the knowledge of dharma, do such a reprehensible and unrighteous deed?
